definitions.explanation: A phone call that includes live video feed, allowing participants to see each other in real time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ビデオ{通話|つうわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I make video calls with my family overseas.

examples.japanese: ビデオ{通話|つうわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: With video calls, you can talk while seeing each other's faces.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ビデオ{通話|つうわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I make a video call on my smartphone.

notes:
ビデオ{通話|つうわ} refers to a phone or internet call with live video, allowing participants to see each other in real time. It covers calls on smartphones, tablets, and computers using apps like LINE, FaceTime, or Zoom.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ビデオ{通話|つうわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a video call
- ビデオ{通話|つうわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to place a video call
- ビデオ{通話|つうわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to answer a video call
